identity.hierarchyPrinciple: Headline, feature cards, and product panel all compete as hero modules.
identity.distinctiveMove: No single content move; identity is attempted through stacked effects.

surfaces.borderStrategy: Bright translucent borders surround every promotional module.
surfaces.shadowStrategy: Colored outer glows separate panels from the dark canvas.

effects.name: aurora-gradient
effects.purpose: Fill the background with ambient product energy.

effects.name: glass-blur
effects.purpose: Separate multiple floating panels from the background.

effects.name: neon-glow
effects.purpose: Make status chips, headline accents, and panels feel active.

effects.name: noise-overlay
effects.purpose: Add synthetic texture across empty regions.

media.treatment: Keep the FinHot UI literal inside a glowing glass product panel.
media.cropPolicy: Preserve the navigation and first feed rows; crop only lower repeated rows.

components.name: hero-headline
components.geometry: Large centered block with gradient-emphasis words.

components.name: feature-cluster
components.purpose: Present the three locked evidence statements.

components.name: product-panel
components.geometry: Large rounded glass window with glow.

do: Keep source and disclaimer inside safe area.
avoid: Do not reuse this warning-heavy baseline in production.
Do not imitate a named brand.
Do not add motion that changes the static experiment.
